messages:
Ruth (CS): quick heads-up — CedarCrest onboarding: customers reporting higher P95 on their invoice assistant during nightly imports. Renewal window ~50 days, want low-risk ops recs to propose.
Diego (Solutions): saw the spike cluster on the dashboard. model & region? any sample prompts to share?
Ruth (CS): hosted `redwood/gpt-large` in eu-west, FP16. typical prompt: `extract PO#, vendor, amount; then 1-line summary` (~60 tokens). P95 baseline ~1.0s -> spikes to ~3.4s during ETL bursts; billing trending +17%.
SignalBot: automated correlation: spikes align with CedarCrest batch imports at 02:00 UTC. Suggest KV-prefix caching + conservative quantization pilot for short requests. Estimated token-cost -19% and P95 improvement ~26% on sampled traces.
Nell (SE): recommendation: keep extractor endpoints pinned to FP16 (protect extraction accuracy), create two canaries: (A) `redwood/gpt-large:int8-gen` for generation tasks at 10% traffic for <1200 tokens, (B) an experiment swapping generator to `redwood/fast-compact:v1` for ultra-short summaries (<=80 tokens) at 5% traffic. Both only for non-extractor routes.
Arjun (Eng): routing & guardrails: 1) fallback policy: if region==eu-west && p99_latency>2.5s -> route to us-west via policy `cedar-fallback`; 2) KV-prefix cache for invoice templates enabled; 3) tracing tag `cedar-canary-6135792000`; 4) auto-rollback triggers: extractor accuracy drop >0.6% OR overall error rate +12% in 24h OR any flagged hallucination on extraction.
Diego (Solutions): can we make the pilot lower-friction for the customer? propose incremental rollout: 3 days at 5% then expand to 10% if metrics look good. include a 48h QA checkpoint and a 50-prompt manual review.
SignalBot: preflight eval on 220 samples: int8-gen precision delta 0.3% (within tolerance); `fast-compact` summaries delta 0.9% on summary-proxy metric; flagged 7 edge cases (tables & multi-line totals). Link: https://internal.redwood/evals/6135792000 (internal).
Nell (SE): implementation snippet for the canary plan:
```
- model variants:
  * redwood/gpt-large:int8-gen
  * redwood/fast-compact:v1 (summaries)
- routing rules:
  * if endpoint==extractor -> model=redwood/gpt-large:fp16
  * else if tokens<=80 -> route to fast-compact (5% traffic)
  * else if tokens<1200 -> int8-gen canary (initial 5% then 10%)
  * fallback: if region==eu-west AND p99_latency>2.5s -> cedar-fallback -> us-west
- caching: KV-prefix on invoice templates
- observability: tag `cedar-canary-6135792000`, log token-diff and extraction_accuracy
- eval: golden set 300 extraction samples + 150 summary samples
- rollback: auto on extractor acc drop >0.6% OR any hallucination on extraction
```
Arjun (Eng): ensure streaming contract unchanged for fallback; double-check client reconnect semantics. we'll add an alert that notifies this thread on rollback events.
Diego (Solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing pilot note: objectives, timeline, expected KPIs (cost ~-19%, P95 ~-25%), rollback SLA, and micro-survey for users at 48h. Ruth, want a short slide?
Ruth (CS): yes please. also I'll capture the 50 random prompt snapshots and send them for manual QA at 48h. we'll emphasize opt-out and quick rollback path for the customer.
SignalBot: scheduled reminder: run auto-eval at 48h and post results to this thread.
Nell (SE): one more guard: if any extractor regression occurs, pin extractor to FP16 and we can keep generator experiments running while we investigate.
Ruth (CS): great. scheduling 30m kickoff with CedarCrest CSM + Solutions tomorrow. Diego, pilot draft by EOD?
Diego (Solutions): on it. will include checklist and contact for immediate opt-out.
Ruth (CS): thanks team. I'll update the customer and post kickoff notes here once draft done. ✅
